title: English Practice Quiz 0831
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: He asked, 'Where do you live?'
options: He asked where do I live.
He asked where did I lived.
He asked where I live do.
questions.explanation: Reported questions use statement word order; do is removed.

questions.question: She is the ___ student in the class.
questions.explanation: Use the superlative tallest when comparing one with the whole class.

questions.question: She ___ to work every day.
questions.explanation: With he, she or it in the present simple, add -s or -es to most verbs.

questions.question: You ___ wear your identity card at work.
questions.explanation: Modal verbs such as should are followed by the base verb without to.

questions.question: She ___ in this hospital for five years.
questions.explanation: The present perfect can describe a situation continuing to the present.

questions.question: A place where medicines are dispensed is a ___.
questions.explanation: A pharmacy is a place where medicines are prepared or supplied.

questions.question: Choose the correct word order.
questions.explanation: Frequency adverbs such as always usually come after the verb be.

questions.question: A colleague asks for help. A polite reply is:
questions.explanation: Certainly. What do you need? is helpful and polite.

questions.question: Read: 'The meeting was cancelled because the manager was ill.' Why was it cancelled?
questions.explanation: The reason is explicitly stated: the manager was ill.
